decisions.reason: The left forbids zero-length Alert content, while the right defines the general TLSInnerPlaintext.content length from TLSPlaintext.length.

The left requires record-fragment sequencing without interleaving, while the right requires receiver reassembly and processing of a fragmented handshake message.
The checks constrain different fields in different messages, with different lower bounds: CertificateVerify.signature and NewSessionTicket.ticket.
PSK key agreement requires both extensions, but using pre_shared_key and using psk_key_exchange_modes are separate implementation checks.
The checks apply different bounds to different vectors: OIDFilterExtension.filters and NewSessionTicket.extensions.
Extension.extension_data permits an empty value, whereas NewSessionTicket.ticket is a different field and must contain at least one octet.
The left permits an unauthenticated client endpoint when client authentication is not selected; the right requires server authentication for the channel.

The left constrains what a legacy-version server sends; the right specifies the client's illegal_parameter failure when ServerHello carries an invalid supported_versions selection.

The checks map different RSA signature schemes to different code points.
